blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) and the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) intercepted 12 kilos of suspected shabu (crystal methamphetamine) at the Batangas City port on Wednesday morning (Oct. 7). The joint operation led to the arrest of four men, aged 18, 29, 30 and 41. The suspects are residents of Malate town in Manila, and Maluso town in Basilan, PCG Batangas said, citing a report from PCG spokesperson Commodore Noemie Cayabyab.
